n: Marutoma Shokudō, Tomakomai (マルトマ食堂)
w: A fishermen's diner facing Tomakomai harbour, open from 5am — Japan's top surf-clam port served as a heaped hokki curry and seafood bowls.

dish: Muroran yakitori — pork and onion skewers with karashi mustard
n: Yakitori no Ippei Nakajima Honten, Muroran (やきとりの一平 中島本店)
w: The shop that put Muroran 'yakitori' — charcoal pork and onion, eaten with hot mustard — on the national map by winning the Yakitorimpic twice.
